single.title: One-time Audit
single.description: Full technical audit of one website with 40+ parameters checked: Core Web Vitals performance, SEO optimization, usability and accessibility. You will receive a structured report with prioritized recommendations — from critical issues to fine-tuning improvements. Traffic and conversion growth forecast, 4-week implementation roadmap. Everything you need to turn your website into a source of stable organic traffic.

monthly.title: Subscription
monthly.description: Monthly audit of up to 5 websites with extended analysis: technical metrics, SEO strategy, UX/UI, competitor benchmarking. Priority report processing within 24 hours, personalized recommendations for each project. Includes weekly monitoring, competitor comparison and API access for integration with your systems. Perfect for agencies, SEO professionals and marketing teams managing multiple projects.

offer.title: Public Offer
offer.general_text:
1.1. This public offer is an official proposal to any individual or legal entity to conclude an agreement for the provision of website auditing services using artificial intelligence.

1.2. The Offer comes into force from the moment of publication on the website https://aicrorauditor.com and is valid until the moment of its withdrawal by the Executor.

1.3. Acceptance of the Offer is the payment by the Customer for the Executor's services in accordance with Section 4 of this Offer.
offer.services_text:
2.1. The Executor undertakes to provide the Customer with services for AI-audit of the website, and the Customer undertakes to pay for these Services.

2.2. Composition of Services: website analysis using neural networks, identification of technical, SEO and UX/UI issues, preparation of a report with recommendations for improvement.
offer.payment_text:
3.1. The cost of Services is determined according to the current tariffs published on the Executor's website.

3.2. Payment is made with 100% prepayment through the payment system specified on the website.

3.3. The moment of payment is the receipt of funds to the Executor's bank account.
offer.final_text:
5.1. This Offer is governed by the legislation of the Russian Federation.

5.2. All notices and messages under this Offer must be sent in writing by email.

5.3. The Executor reserves the right to make changes to the Offer without prior notice to the Customer. The new version of the Offer comes into force from the moment of its publication on the website.

5.4. The Customer confirms that they have read the terms of the Offer and accept them in full.
